faq.renewHow: How do I keep my number after the plan ends?
faq.answerRenewHow: US and global numbers can be renewed in your account before the plan ends. The renewal is added to your current eSIM and keeps the same number, with no new installation. We send a reminder a few days before it ends. If the plan ends without a renewal, the number is cancelled and cannot be recovered. The French number and local numbers cannot be renewed: a new plan comes with a new number.
